translations.web: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
translations.bsb: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
translations.kjv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
translations.asv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feasts, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
